results.title: Haitians in Maryland live in fear over ICE detentions after end of their TPS status
results.description: More than 350,000 Haitians lost Temporary Protected Status as the Trump administration ramps up ICE arrests. In Maryland, a 17-year-old watched how ICE detained her father and a widowed father fears he too will be arrested. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor reports.
